request.style: English, sea shanty, a gruff crew of men singing in unison with a lead calling, stomping and clapping, concertina and fiddle, rolling 6/8, rough and hearty, 112 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
We sailed from Joppa bound for Tarshish
Heave away, my boys
A stranger slept down in the hold
Heave away, my boys
The Lord hurled a great wind on the sea
Heave away, my boys
The ship was ready to break apart
Heave away, my boys

[Chorus]
Pick me up and throw me in the sea
And the sea will quiet down for thee
For I know it is because of me
This great storm has come upon thee

[Verse]
We cast the lots and they fell on him
Heave away, my boys
I fear the Lord who made the sea
Heave away, my boys
We rowed hard but we could not land
Heave away, my boys
So we threw him in and the sea was calm
Heave away, my boys

[Chorus]
Pick me up and throw me in the sea
And the sea will quiet down for thee
For I know it is because of me
This great storm has come upon thee
